summary: The diff implements all four requirements (REQ-29, REQ-30, REQ-31, REQ-32) with high fidelity. The subscription plans screen, payment method selector, 3-dot kebab menu header, and backend subscription plan data structure are all present. However, there are notable gaps: the backend SubscriptionPlan type uses Float for price instead of Text as specified in REQ-32, the stable state is not initialized with Monthly and Yearly plan records, and the payment methods section appears only in PaymentMethodSelectorScreen rather than on the subscription plans screen itself.

missing_requirements.requirement: SubscriptionPlan record type must have price as Text and billingCycle as Text
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo defines price as Float and billingCycle as a Motoko variant type (#monthly/#yearly) rather than Text fields as specified in the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Stable state initialized with Monthly and Yearly plan records
missing_requirements.reason: The subscriptionPlans map is declared with Map.empty with no stable keyword and no initialization with Monthly/Yearly plan records. The AC explicitly requires stable state pre-populated with both plans.

missing_requirements.requirement: Payment methods section must be displayed on the subscription plans screen itself
missing_requirements.reason: REQ-30 states the subscription plans screen should display a payment methods section. The payment methods are only shown in a separate PaymentMethodSelectorScreen navigated to after clicking Subscribe, not on SubscriptionPlansScreen directly.

hallucinated_features.description: addSubscriptionPlan admin-only mutation function added to the backend
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-32 only requested a getSubscriptionPlans query function and stable plan storage. An addSubscriptionPlan admin mutation was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: BillingCycle variant type introduced in backend instead of Text
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specified billingCycle as Text, but a Motoko variant type was used instead, which is a structural deviation not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Mock payment success screen with simulated 2-second processing delay
hallucinated_features.reason: While a UI-only mock flow was requested, a full success/confirmation screen with animated processing state was not explicitly specified in the requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: useGetSubscriptionPlans React Query hook added as a separate file
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not specify a frontend query hook for subscription plans; this is an additional convenience layer not mentioned in requirements.
